wayIn.name: the threshold
wayIn.what: Start here: answer one sideways question for a suggested world, or skip it and open any world card.

wayIn.name: the mood atlas
wayIn.gloss: how it asks, and every answer
wayIn.what: Try every question style, see every orientation it can read, then jump straight into the world that matches what you picked.

wayIn.name: site map
wayIn.what: Scan the whole site in one pass, with one plain line on what each page does and what to try first.

worlds.name: the quiet room
worlds.what: A breath to follow at your pace, or one thing to set down and leave down; the room goes dark when you are done.

worlds.name: the wish constellation
worlds.what: Your sky asked for a reading, showered with meteors to catch, or set turning once around, with a postcard at the end.

worlds.name: the diary
worlds.what: A logbook entry written from where your stars sit and sealed in wax, or the thoughts called back one by one in the order they came.

worlds.name: the echo chamber
worlds.what: Pulse your saved sky into drifting echoes, click one thought at a time, then print an echo weather bulletin.

worlds.name: the pulse choir
worlds.what: Turn your saved stars into a looping choir, conduct it by tempo and muting, and print a constellation score.

worlds.name: the lantern ritual
worlds.what: Your stars as lanterns: choose the order, kindle them one by one, set the wind, and let them rise.

worlds.name: the terrarium
worlds.what: A glasshouse grown from your stars: a watering round, a greenhouse forecast, or the bed regrown in an order you choose.

worlds.name: the weather lab
worlds.what: A weather map over your stars: set the hour, name the front, probe the field, and read the forecast.

worlds.name: the orbital weaver
worlds.what: Your stars woven into a wheel: set the spokes, spin or rest it, drop ripples into the weave, and a mantra at the end.

worlds.name: the machine shop
worlds.what: One rule on the bench: pick a starting tape, tune the rule, run it, and read its eight bits.

worlds.name: the kinetic floor
worlds.what: A floor of blocks: shove them, flip the gravity, choose what they are made of, and wind up the kicker.

worlds.name: loam
worlds.what: A bed of soil: set the grit, plant a few named things, water them, and turn the soil until something comes up.

worlds.name: the word kiln
worlds.what: Words fired in a kiln: choose three off the shelf or coin them for a book that does not exist, set the heat, and read what comes out.

worlds.name: the apocrypha desk
worlds.what: A desk of dubious objects: accession a specimen or cross-reference the drawer, and fill in the index card.

worlds.name: the archive oracle
worlds.what: The sky under a wheel of runes: spin for an omen, forge a sigil from your stars, or read them one by one.

edges.name: lost in space
edges.what: Miss a page and you still land in the river: whatever comes next opens here, and every world is below.

edges.name: sitemap.xml
edges.what: The same page list in XML, using relative paths so the site works under any publish path.
